bestRoute: Route 2 — Acidic Hydrothermal HCl / Se / SeO₂
summary: InSe₃Cl₂ is best viewed as a metastable rather than ground-state target because E_hull = 0.130 eV/atom. [Target] The synthesis evidence is reasonably supportive because SS and TS include Se-rich halide phases made by hydrothermal, solvothermal, and CVT routes.
